description: Shared network fixtures: the transport server's reviewed answers, first generated by the removed Rust server (Git history: crates/agentbox/src/network/fixtures_tests.rs) and asserted by the Python server's suite (tests/server/test_broker.py SharedFixtures). authorities: CONNECT authority-form targets, parsed to {host: {name}|{ip}, port} or a fixed code. denied: an address's dial denial (unspecified, its IPv4-mapped form) or null. policies: documents (text, or document_hex for raw bytes), with optional session grants, parsed to their identity or a fixed code. decisions: a policy with optional grants, an authority and resolver answers, decided to the dialed targets or a fixed code. heads: CONNECT heads (text, or head_hex) under the default head limits (8192 bytes, 1024-byte line, 32 fields), to {connect: authority}, {post: length} or a fixed code. Changes are reviewed edits of the expectations; no implementation rewrites them.
